source.check: returned unopposed: sole nomination for the aldermanship; the only contests were the Inver aldermanship and Gardenmore's councillorships (Belfast News-Letter, 8 May 1958, p. 6; Larne Times, 8 May 1958, p. 6)

note: Election of the Larne Borough Council, May 1958: one alderman and two councillors for each of the five wards. Twelve of the fifteen members were renominated. Polls on Wednesday 21 May 1958 only for the Inver aldermanship (A. H. Girvan defeated J. L. Hogg) and the two Gardenmore councillorships (Larne Times, 29 May 1958, p. 8). Central and Inver each had one nomination for their two councillorships, and a councillor's seat in each was vacant on the new council. In Curran and Townparks the three nominees for alderman and councillors were returned unopposed; the report does not say which was the alderman, so each ward is filed as one return. No party labels are printed. The nomination report lists the ward's nominees without offices; the alderman is identified as the nominee who was not a candidate for the councillorships (Central: one councillor nomination, H. M'Kay; Gardenmore: the councillor contest was between T. D. McKeever, Mrs. M. W. Bawn and W. J. J. Johnston), and was the sitting alderman of 1952. Returned unopposed.
